## Zanskar River Expedition — Gear Checklist

**Conditions to design for:** near-freezing glacial water, 3,000–4,000 m altitude, 8 days fully self-sufficient, 150 km descent, no resupply.

### 1. Safety Gear (non-negotiable)

rows: Type III whitewater PFD (20+ lb buoyancy)
Drysuit or 5/4 mm wetsuit + neoprene hood
Decathlon, Amazon.in (catalogue's 8 °C bag is too warm)

blocks.heading: 5. Weight Limits for the 150 km Descent
items: **Personal pack (gear + food + water): keep under 15–20 kg.** - **Total per person (all gear): aim under 25 kg** — anything heavier slows portages and strains the raft. - **Shared group gear** (tents, stove, rescue line, spare paddle) distributed evenly across the team. - **Raft load:** 4–5 people + gear per raft; balance weight fore/aft for stable handling in rapids. - **Rule of thumb:** if your pack exceeds 25 kg, cut food weight (switch to lighter dehydrated meals) before cutting safety gear.

blocks.text: **Bengaluru-specific:** Decathlon (Indiranagar / Phoenix Mall), Amazon.in for most items, and specialty rafting/diving shops for drysuits, PFDs, and paddles. For a full expedition load-out, a dedicated outdoor gear store in Bengaluru can source
